The branching model of the repository, as an option: gitflow (the default), github_flow, gitlab_flow, trunk or release_flow. It creates the model's branches after the first commit (develop, for gitflow), writes tasks that run the model with plain git (task feature:start -- login, task release:finish...), which never push, runs the CI on the model's branches, and explains the model in CONTRIBUTING.md. task github:protect asks GitHub to require pull requests and a green CI on the long-lived branches, when you run it.

```esquadro
blueprint branching
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [app](../app/), [git](../git/): the app must use them too.
- **Works with** [github_actions](../github_actions/) when the app uses them.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | string | `"gitflow"` | gitflow, github_flow, gitlab_flow, trunk or release_flow. |
| `main` | string | `"main"` | The branch of what is in production. |
| `develop` | string | `"develop"` | gitflow: the branch where work is integrated. |
| `environments` | list | `["staging", "production"]` | gitlab_flow: the environment branches, in the order code is promoted. |

```esquadro
blueprint branching {
  model "gitflow"
}
```

## Hooks

- `post-gen` setup
